info.title: Coasty Public API
info.summary: Computer Use Agents, scheduled automation, and managed VMs.
info.description:
# Coasty Public API

Coasty is a Computer Use Agent (CUA) platform: predict actions from screenshots,
provision managed VMs, and run scheduled automation against them.

## Authentication

All endpoints (except `/v1/triggers/webhook/{webhook_id}` and health checks) require an API key.
Pass it as either:

- `X-API-Key: sk-coasty-live-...` (or `sk-coasty-test-...` for sandbox)
- `Authorization: Bearer sk-coasty-live-...`

The external webhook endpoint does not use an API key, but it is authenticated:
send the HMAC-SHA256 `Coasty-Signature` credential documented on that operation.

Test-mode keys (`sk-coasty-test-*`) hit the same validation paths as live keys but
return mock VMs / mock action results and never bill credits — ideal for CI.

## Pricing & budgeting

Per-call rates (subject to change — see `lib/pricing/tiers.ts METERED_RATES`):

| Endpoint | Credits |
|---|---|
| `POST /v1/predict` | ~5 |
| `POST /v1/sessions` | 10 |
| `POST /v1/sessions/{id}/predict` | ~4 |
| `POST /v1/ground` | ~3 |
| `POST /v1/parse` | 0 (free) |

Long-running CUA jobs orchestrated through the dashboard (not this API) bill at
10 credits/minute with a 20-credit minimum. Subscription tiers (`free | starter |
professional | enterprise`) gate feature availability (e.g. custom system prompts),
schedule counts, and the maximum trajectory length.

## Errors

Every error response uses the same envelope:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS",
    "message": "Need 5, have 2.",
    "type": "billing_error",
    "request_id": "req_a1b2c3d4e5f6",
    "retryable": false,
    "retry_with_same_idempotency_key": false
  }
}
```

Include the `request_id` in support requests.

## Idempotency

Operations marked `x-idempotency: reserve-and-replay` accept `Idempotency-Key:
<≤128 chars of [A-Za-z0-9_-:]>`. Replays
of the same key + identical body return the original response (with
`X-Coasty-Idempotent-Replay: true`) for 24 h. Reusing the key with a different body
is a 422 `IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED`.
Operations marked `x-idempotency: webhook-payload-dedup` instead deduplicate the
same webhook id + identical raw body for 60 seconds; they do not accept an
Idempotency-Key.

## Clients & MCP

Use the HTTP API directly from any language. Official TypeScript and Python SDKs
are not currently published; generate a client from this OpenAPI document if needed.
- MCP server: `npx -y @coasty/mcp` (see `x-mcp-server`)

## Reference

Complete (machine-readable) spec is hosted at `/.well-known/openapi.json` and
`/openapi.json` (Stripe / Vercel conventions).

servers.description: Sandbox — use sk-coasty-test-* keys against the same host. No billing, mock VMs.

tags.description: Stateless CUA action prediction and grounding.

tags.name: sessions
tags.description: Stateful CUA sessions with persistent trajectory.

tags.description: Cron and one-shot scheduled CUA jobs.

tags.description: Webhook and chain triggers for schedules.

tags.description: API key management and usage reporting.

tags.description: Autonomous task runs — the agent drives a task to completion on a machine.

tags.description: Versioned, branching multi-step automations (DSL) and their runs.

post.description: Send a screenshot + instruction; receive a list of structured actions to execute on the target machine. Costs ~5 credits/call (varies by CUA version, screenshot size, trajectory length). See lib/pricing/tiers.ts METERED_RATES for budgeting.

text/event-stream.description: SSE keepalive stream ending with a JSON result event. Request with Accept: text/event-stream.

post.description: Persistent session with a 2-hour (7200s) idle TTL, reset on each predict/reset; expires_at is returned. A predict/reset against an expired or unknown session is a 404 SESSION_NOT_FOUND. Maintains trajectory across predictions. Concurrent-session limits are tier- and deployment-configured; clients must handle 429 responses instead of hardcoding a tier limit.

200.description: Predicted actions for the next step.

text/event-stream.description: SSE keepalive stream ending with a JSON result event. Request with Accept: text/event-stream.

post.description: Find (x, y) for a described UI element. ~3 credits/call.

post.summary: Parse pyautogui code into structured actions
post.description: Free, no LLM call. Returns structured Action objects.

get.summary: List available models, CUA versions, and action types
Usage summary for a billing period

schema.description: ISO YYYY-MM with a real month 01..12 (defaults to current month).

get.description: Collect a prior mutating call's result by its Idempotency-Key alone (for clients that lost the original response). 'completed' returns the original body + original_status; 'processing' means it is still running; unknown/expired is 404.

200.description: The cached result (completed) or its in-flight status (processing).

post.description: Returns the raw key ONCE. Subsequent reads only return the prefix.

get.description: Scope: `llm_keys` (granted to new live keys by default). Requires a live API key; sandbox keys cannot inspect the production credential store. Returns non-secret metadata only — provider, sha256-prefix fingerprint, timestamps. The key itself is never returned.

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: The BYOK provider: anthropic or openai. 'managed' has no storable key and any other value is 422 LLM_PROVIDER_UNSUPPORTED.

put.summary: Store (upsert) your own provider LLM key
put.description: Scope: `llm_keys`. Requires a live API key; sandbox keys cannot modify the production credential store. Stores the caller's own Anthropic/OpenAI API key for BYOK, AES-256-GCM encrypted at rest. The plaintext key exists only in this request body; every response carries only the non-secret sha256-prefix `key_fingerprint` — the key is never returned, logged, or echoed again. Naturally idempotent (an upsert), so no Idempotency-Key is needed.

200.description: Key stored (fingerprint only; the key is never returned again).

delete.summary: Delete your stored BYOK LLM key
delete.description: Scope: `llm_keys`. Requires a live API key; sandbox keys cannot modify the production credential store. Deletes the stored key for the provider — 404 LLM_KEY_NOT_FOUND when none exists. Schedules that opted into this provider then fail loudly at fire time with LLM_KEY_NOT_CONFIGURED; they never silently run on Coasty's platform keys.

post.description: Managed VM provisioning. Linux defaults are cheap (1 cpu / 2 GB / 10 GB) and bill at agent-minute rates. Test keys (sk-coasty-test-*) return mock VMs with no cloud calls.

get.summary: Get the live machine runtime rate card
get.description: Scope: `machines:read`. Returns runtime rates, one-time charges, billing granularity, insufficient-funds behavior, and TTL bounds.

200.description: Current machine pricing and lease policy.

get.summary: What is billing me right now
get.description: Lists every API-billed machine currently metering your wallet (running OR stopped — stopped bills at the storage-only rate). current_run_rate_cents_per_hour is the summed instantaneous burn rate. Test-mode keys return an empty fleet (active: [], rate 0). 1 credit = 1 cent.

delete.description: Irreversible. Stops billing the agent-minute rate.

patch.summary: Set, extend, or clear a machine auto-destroy lease
patch.description: Scope: `machines:write`. `ttl_minutes=0` clears auto-destroy; values 5..10080 schedule termination from now.

post.description: Captures a restorable machine image. Requires `snapshots:write`. The configured one-time fee is charged before dispatch. A conclusive pre-creation rejection is refunded; a timeout, 5xx, or malformed post-dispatch result may already have created the image and returns terminal 503 SNAPSHOT_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN without a blind refund/re-execution.

get.summary: Capture a screenshot of the machine

get.description: Returns plaintext credentials. Gated by `connection:read` scope. Response is `Cache-Control: no-store`. Store credentials in a secrets manager — Coasty cannot re-issue them; rotate by terminating + reprovisioning.

post.summary: Execute a single action on the machine
post.description: Required scope varies by command: terminal_* → `terminal:exec`; file_* → `files:read|write`; browser_execute → `browser:execute`; everything else → `actions:exec`. See the ActionRequest command enum and /v1/models for current capabilities.
Shell `&&`-style semantics: aborts on first failure when `stop_on_error=true` (default).

parameters.name: op
parameters.description: Browser sub-op. One of: open, navigate, click, type, dom, clickables, state, info, scroll, close, screenshot, wait, list-tabs, open-tab, close-tab, switch-tab.

post.description: Output truncated VM-side to 5000 chars. Hard cap 120s (Cloudflare edge timeout). Requires `terminal:exec` scope.

parameters.name: op
parameters.description: File sub-op. Read scope: read, exists, list, list-directory, download, list-downloads. Write scope: write, edit, append, delete, delete-directory.

post.description: Read ops require `files:read`; mutating ops require `files:write`. Body capped at 50 MB.

Cron-based or one-shot (run_at) scheduled task. Schedule-count limits are tier- and deployment-configured; clients must handle the structured limit response rather than hardcoding plan values. BYOK: schedules store only the non-secret llm preference; at fire time the CURRENT stored key is used — if it was deleted, firings fail loudly with LLM_KEY_NOT_CONFIGURED instead of silently running on platform keys.

get.summary: List historical runs of a schedule
List triggers attached to a schedule

post.description: For `webhook`, the response includes a one-time HMAC `webhook_secret` — store it now or rotate the trigger. Chain triggers support a max depth of 5.

post.summary: Fire a schedule from an HMAC-authenticated external webhook
post.description: No Coasty API key is used. The request is authenticated with HMAC-SHA256 over `<unix_ts>.<body>` using the secret from trigger creation. Send either `Coasty-Signature: t=<ts>,v1=<sig>` or its `X-Coasty-Signature` compatibility alias. Replay window 5 minutes. Body capped at 1 MB. Repeated identical (webhook_id, body) within 60s are deduped.

parameters.name: Coasty-Signature
parameters.description: Primary HMAC credential. Exactly one supported signature header is required.

parameters.name: X-Coasty-Signature
parameters.description: Compatibility alias for Coasty-Signature. Send one signature header, not both.

error.message: An error occurred. See `code` for details.

429.description: Webhook per-minute rate limit exceeded. Honor Retry-After.

error.message: An error occurred. See `code` for details.

post.description: Scope: `runs:write`. Drives `task` to completion on `machine_id`, running the screenshot→act→verify loop server-side. Each agent step bills at the /v1/predict rate (~5 credits/step, scales with cua_version); a 402 is returned up front if the wallet cannot afford one step. Test keys (sk-coasty-test-*) never bill. `webhook_secret` is returned ONCE. BYOK: opt in via the body `llm` block or the X-LLM-* headers and every LLM call runs on YOUR provider key; the key is snapshotted encrypted for crash-recovery and scrubbed at terminal state.

get.description: Scope: `runs:read`. Free. Optional `status` filter and `limit` (1-200, default 20).
Scope: `runs:read`. Free. Returns status, result, and credits charged.

Scope: `runs:read`. Free. A durable Server-Sent Events stream. Resume with the `Last-Event-ID` header or `?after=<seq>`. The edge may rotate a connection after 300 seconds, so reconnect with the last sequence until a terminal `done` event arrives.

text/event-stream.description: A Server-Sent Events byte stream. Each frame carries an event name/id and JSON in its data field; reconnect with Last-Event-ID.

post.description: Scope: `runs:write`. Free. Cancels an in-flight run.

post.summary: Resume a run after human takeover
post.description: Scope: `runs:write`. Free. Resumes a run paused in `awaiting_human`. Body is optional.
Scope: `workflows:write`. Free (definition only). Creates a versioned workflow from a DSL `definition`.

Scope: `workflows:write`. Runs an inline `definition` without saving it. Each `task` step bills at the /v1/predict rate under the optional `budget_cents` cap; other step types are free. Test keys never bill. `webhook_secret` is returned ONCE.

get.description: Scope: `workflows:read`. Free. Optional `workflow_id` filter and `limit` (1-200, default 20).

Scope: `workflows:read`. Free. Durable SSE stream; resume with `Last-Event-ID` or `?after=<seq>`. The edge may rotate a connection after 300 seconds, so reconnect with the last sequence until the terminal event arrives.

text/event-stream.description: A Server-Sent Events byte stream. Each frame carries an event name/id and JSON in its data field; reconnect with Last-Event-ID.

post.description: Scope: `workflows:write`. Free.

post.summary: Approve or reject a paused workflow run
post.description: Scope: `workflows:write`. Free. Approves (continues) or rejects (fails) a run paused on a `human_approval` step.

post.summary: Start a run of a saved workflow
post.description: Scope: `workflows:write`. Runs the saved workflow. Each `task` step bills at the /v1/predict rate under the optional `budget_cents` cap; other steps are free. Test keys never bill. `webhook_secret` is returned ONCE. BYOK: opt in via the body `llm` block or the X-LLM-* headers to run every task step's LLM calls on YOUR provider key (no silent fallback).

bearerAuth.description: Equivalent to X-API-Key. Use whichever your client supports.

webhookHmac.name: Coasty-Signature
webhookHmac.description: HMAC-SHA256 credential for external schedule webhooks: t=<unix_ts>,v1=<hex_digest>.

webhookHmacLegacy.name: X-Coasty-Signature
webhookHmacLegacy.description: Compatibility alias for the Coasty-Signature HMAC credential.

code.description: Stable machine-readable error code (e.g. INVALID_API_KEY, INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS).

message.description: Human-readable explanation. May include suggestions or examples.

request_id.description: Server-assigned correlation ID. Include in support requests.

suggestion.description: A concrete next step, auto-filled per code. LLM agents can act on it to self-recover.

retryable.description: true when retrying the same call may succeed (transient server failures + back-pressure: INTERNAL_ERROR, DB_UNAVAILABLE, SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE, UPSTREAM_*, PREDICTION_FAILED, *_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, TOO_MANY_RUNS, IDEMPOTENCY_IN_FLIGHT, ...). false for deterministic client errors. A CUA BILLING_UNAVAILABLE caused by refund uncertainty is false unless the server confirmed a shared recovery checkpoint. Present on EVERY error envelope, including gateway/5xx/timeout paths.

retry_with_same_idempotency_key.description: true only when the concrete response permits replay, the original operation is one of the exact 18 reserve-and-replay operations, and that original request already carried the key. Reuse that SAME key and identical body. A retryable error alone does not make an operation idempotent, and a key cannot be added retroactively. For CUA refund uncertainty this is true only after an exact shared checkpoint was confirmed; unkeyed or uncheckpointed responses are false and must not be retried automatically. A confirmed refunded failure sets this false even when retryable remains true: use a new key, because the old debit is compensated and wallet-guarded by IDEMPOTENCY_ALREADY_REFUNDED. false for deterministic errors.

retry_after.description: Seconds to wait before retrying (accompanies retryable:true back-pressure codes; mirrors the Retry-After header).

examples.description: Machine-readable limits for self-correction. On PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE / INVALID_SCREENSHOT: { max_base64_bytes: 10485760, max_mb: 10, min_base64_chars: 100, formats: ["png","jpeg"] }.

IdempotencyLookupResponse.description: Result of GET /v1/idempotency/{key}. 'completed' returns the original response body + original_status; 'processing' means the original is still running; an unknown/expired key is a 404 NOT_FOUND.

status.description: completed = a cached result is included; processing = the original is still executing.

anyOf.description: The original response body, verbatim. Present only when status is 'completed'.

original_status.description: The HTTP status the original response returned (e.g. 200). Present only when status is 'completed'.

breakdown.description: Self-auditable per-call cost breakdown; line credits sum to credits_charged. null on free/test/no-charge calls and /v1/parse.

count.description: Optional multiplier (e.g. number of HD screenshots billed); omitted where it adds nothing.

billed.description: true on a real billed call; false on test keys (sk-coasty-test-*) and on idempotent replays (which return credits_charged: 0).

cua_version.description: v1 = baseline (single action, reflection, 8-step trajectory, 9-10s). v3 = lean (multi-action, no reflection, 3.5-4s). v4 = autonomous + verifier. v5 = latest (default): autonomous + verifier with improved grounding and recovery.

screen_width.description: Omit to use the screenshot's true size (measured server-side); no longer defaults to 1920.

screen_height.description: Omit to use the screenshot's true size (measured server-side); no longer defaults to 1080.

cua_version.description: Echo: the CUA engine version that actually served this call (e.g. "v5").

screen_width.description: Echo: the width the server actually used — the coordinate space the returned (x, y) are in.

screen_height.description: Echo: the height the server actually used — the coordinate space the returned (x, y) are in.

key.description: The raw API key. Returned ONCE only.

key_prefix.description: Stored 16-character identification prefix; never the full secret.

billing.description: How this API-provisioned machine is metered (omitted for non-API machines).

suspended_for_billing.description: true if stopped because the wallet ran dry.

ssh_private_key_pem.description: ED25519 (Linux) or RSA (Windows) private key. HIGHLY SENSITIVE — store in a secrets manager.

Open directly in a browser or iframe to view AND control the desktop — no IP/port/password needed. Null when not available for this machine (use public_ip + vnc_port + vnc_password instead). Expires (~1h); re-fetch from this endpoint to refresh.

metadata.description: Opaque key/value map echoed back (≤50 keys).

llm.description: Non-secret BYOK echo when the run opted into the caller's own key: {provider, model, key_fingerprint, key_source, key_scrubbed}. key_source is 'stored' or 'header'; key_scrubbed flips to true when the encrypted snapshot is destroyed at terminal state. Never contains the key.

webhook_secret.description: Returned ONCE on create; null on get/list. Verify deliveries with HMAC-SHA256.

RunEvent.description: One Server-Sent Event in a run stream. The SSE `data:` field carries this JSON; `id:` carries the resumable `seq` cursor.

seq.description: Monotonic cursor; pass via Last-Event-ID or ?after= to resume.

type.description: Event type (e.g. status, step, awaiting_human, done).

budget_cents.description: Hard spend cap across all task steps; 0 or null = unlimited.

definition.description: Inline DSL for an ad-hoc run (POST /v1/workflows/runs). Omit when running a saved workflow.

approved.description: Approve (continue) or reject (fail) the pending human_approval step.

LlmConfig.description: Opt-in BYOK model selection. provider 'managed' (or omitting llm) keeps the platform default. There is deliberately no api_key field (422 if attempted): keys ride the X-LLM-Api-Key header or the encrypted /v1/llm/keys store only. Once BYOK is requested there is NO silent fallback to Coasty's platform LLM keys.

provider.description: Whose LLM account runs the harness. Anything else is 422 LLM_PROVIDER_UNSUPPORTED.

model.description: Main worker model. Defaults: claude-sonnet-4-6 (anthropic), gpt-4o (openai). Any model string your account can access; must be vision-capable.

grounding_model.description: Override for pixel-coordinate grounding. Defaults to model. Grounding quality is tuned on the platform model; expect best results with the defaults.

compaction_model.description: Override for trajectory compaction. Defaults to model. A cheaper model here is the classic cost tune.

code_agent_model.description: Override for the code agent. Defaults to model.

api_key.description: Your own provider API key (sk-ant-... for anthropic, sk-... for openai). AES-256-GCM encrypted at rest; never returned or logged.

key_fingerprint.description: Non-secret sha256-prefix fingerprint of the stored key. The key itself is never returned again.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Optional client-supplied key (≤128 chars, [A-Za-z0-9_-:]) for safe retries. 'Same request' = a SHA-256 of the canonical (sorted-key) JSON body (session_id is folded in for /sessions/{id}/predict). Replays the original response for 24 h when the body hash matches (X-Coasty-Idempotent-Replay: true and X-Credits-Charged: 0). Inference replays also set body usage.credits_charged=0 and usage.billed=false; machine-snapshot bodies retain the original gross charge for auditability. A retry while the original is still running waits up to ~25 s then returns the result, otherwise 409 IDEMPOTENCY_IN_FLIGHT (retry with the SAME key). Returns 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED if the body differs. Collect a lost result via GET /v1/idempotency/{key}.

XLLMProvider.name: X-LLM-Provider
XLLMProvider.description: BYOK: which provider the X-LLM-Api-Key belongs to (anthropic | openai). Required whenever X-LLM-Api-Key is sent — a key without a provider is a 422 LLM_PROVIDER_UNSUPPORTED. Selecting a BYOK provider (here or via the body llm.provider) runs the ENTIRE harness on your own account with no silent fallback to Coasty's platform LLM keys.

XLLMApiKey.name: X-LLM-Api-Key
XLLMApiKey.description: BYOK: your own provider API key, used for this request only. Takes precedence over the key stored via PUT /v1/llm/keys/{provider}. Never logged, never echoed in any response, webhook, or idempotency replay.

XLLMModel.name: X-LLM-Model
XLLMModel.description: BYOK: model override for this request (equivalent to body llm.model). Defaults: claude-sonnet-4-6 (anthropic), gpt-4o (openai). Any model string your account can access; must be vision-capable.

MachineId.name: machine_id
MachineId.description: Machine UUID, or `mch_test_<8-32 lowercase hex>` for sandbox/test-mode keys.

ScheduleId.name: schedule_id
ScheduleId.description: Schedule UUID, or `sch_test_<8-32 lowercase hex>` for sandbox keys.

SessionId.name: session_id
SessionId.description: Stateful CUA session identifier (1-128 URL-safe characters).

IdempotencyKeyPath.name: key
IdempotencyKeyPath.description: The Idempotency-Key whose result you want to collect (≤128 chars, [A-Za-z0-9_-:]).

RunId.name: run_id
RunId.description: Run UUID (also used for workflow runs).

LastEventId.name: Last-Event-ID
LastEventId.description: Last processed SSE sequence number. Reconnect with this value to resume without gaps.

CoastyRequestId.description: Coasty correlation identifier for this request.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying. Present on retryable back-pressure and transient failures.

KeyKind.description: Whether the authenticated key is live or test.

TestMode.description: true when the request executed against the sandbox namespace.

IdempotentReplay.description: true when this is a stored response replay rather than a new execution.

IdempotencyReplayed.description: true when this response replays a completed attempt; false for a fresh execution.

IdempotencyStatus.description: Lifecycle status of the canonical idempotent attempt when applicable.

CreditsCharged.description: Credits charged by this response (zero for sandbox keys and stored replays).

CreditsRemaining.description: Authoritative post-charge API-wallet balance in USD cents, when available.

CreditsRefunded.description: Credits durably returned to the wallet after a failed billed operation.

RateLimit.description: Effective request limit for the current window.

RateRemaining.description: Requests remaining in the current window.

RateReset.description: Unix timestamp when the current rate window resets.

x-mcp-server.name: @coasty/mcp
x-mcp-server.description: Coasty's Model Context Protocol server. Wires the /v1/* surface plus pricing into any MCP-compatible client (Claude Desktop, Cursor, etc.).
